title: Household Fee Relief on Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Catch-Up Payments
content:
**Household relief terms.** The household's other Ridgeline business gives the household relief share on a catch-up payment for a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan): a closed entry or patio door contract paid by cash, check or card takes the door-customer relief share of 20%; otherwise an active CareLine service plan takes the CareLine relief share of 15%; otherwise none.

Part of the fee pool, being the late fees, returned-payment fees and phone payment fees posted in the three months before the payment less the fee reversals posted in those months (a pool below zero counts as zero), is left on the balance instead of being collected in the catch-up payment. Where more than one relief share applies to the same catch-up payment, the shares are added together; the relief is the combined share times the fee pool, rounded to the cent and never more than the fee pool, and the catch-up payment is the catch-up figure less the relief, rounded to the cent and never below zero. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

A CareLine service plan here means a CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan in active status; an On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan. The door contract is read from the customer's Entry & Patio Door Contracts records (payment method and status) and the plan from the customer's CareLine Service Plans records.

| Closed door contract paid by cash, check or card | Active CareLine plan | Household relief share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 20% |
| Yes | No | 20% |
| No | Yes | 15% |
| No | No | None |

**Hypothetical illustration.** Fee pool 64.00 and an active CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan with no closed cash-paid door contract, no other relief share: relief 15% of 64.00, 9.60.
